name: Meo Constantini
features: olive skin, dark hair, brown eyes, lean build, sharp features, determined expression, clean-shaven
bio: Bartolomeo 'Meo' Costantini was an Italian racing driver and team manager for Bugatti. He won the Targa Florio in 1925 and 1926 and later became the racing team director for Bugatti, managing some of their most successful years.
